name: prepare_booking
description: Step one of every booking and every move. Call it once the caller has chosen a slot and you have collected the details, BEFORE anything is written. It checks the slot is free, freezes every detail, and returns readback_fr and readback_en: the ONE sentence you must read to the caller, word for word. Read the one in the caller's current language, verbatim, as a single sentence, and let the caller answer it. It also returns a token. Nothing is reserved yet, nothing is written yet. If the caller changes ANY detail after the read-back — the service, the vehicle, the name, the phone number, the day, the date or the time — call this tool again and read the NEW sentence it returns. Never re-use a token, and never say the appointment is booked until book_appointment or move_appointment has returned ok:true. To move an existing appointment, pass booking_ref_to_move together with the phone number on that booking; the tool checks both and returns error "phone_mismatch" if they do not match.

slot_id.description: The slot_id returned by find_slots for the time the caller chose.

customer_name.description: The caller's full name. Required for a booking. Omit for a move unless the name is changing — the tool takes it from the booking being moved.

phone.description: The caller's phone number, digits only or with separators. For a move, it must be the number on the booking being moved.

vin_or_vehicle.description: The VIN if the caller gave one, otherwise the vehicle as year, make and model, e.g. "2018 Honda Civic". Omit for a move unless the vehicle is changing.

service_type.description: The service being booked. Omit for a move unless the service is changing.

items.description: A second service code for the same visit.

additional_services.description: Any SECOND service the caller wants in the same visit, beyond service_type. Omit when there is only one service. Both services appear in the read-back.

language.description: The language the caller is speaking right now. Both read-backs come back regardless; this only sets the extra time strings.

booking_ref_to_move.description: Only for a move: the booking reference in the form GAL-XXXXX of the appointment being moved. Omit entirely for a new booking.
